-98.57380,29.51030.name: Fertility Center of San Antonio
-98.57380,29.51030.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Gregory S. Neal, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

73.77577,18.57674.name: Ashwini Hospital
73.77577,18.57674.desc: A clinic mapped in OpenStreetMap as offering fertility treatment. OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. That is the reverse of the national registers alongside it, which are close to complete for one country and silent everywhere else. This layer is a cross-check and a source of leads, not a count.

-93.34436,45.10048.name: BioSim Innovations
-93.34436,45.10048.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

9.97306,53.59399.name: The Heinrich Pette Institute, Leibniz Institute for Experimental Virology
9.97306,53.59399.desc: A BSL3+ laboratory, operational. Run by University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf. It is categorised as a university laboratory, working on human health. Operational or announced: 1948. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

32.61000,0.47000.name: National Agricultural Research Organisation — Uganda
32.61000,0.47000.desc: Developed disease-resistant banana and cassava, both staples eaten directly by tens of millions in the region. Uganda’s biosafety bill passed parliament twice and was returned unsigned twice, so the research exists and the legal route to release it does not — the clearest case anywhere of a country having the product and not the permission.
